say:3:1320319001:1.text: I can tell from your faces that you've found the painter.
say:3:1320319001:1.source_cn: 看你们的神色，想必已经找到那位画家了。

choice_prompt:4:1320319001.text: I can tell from your faces that you've found the painter.
choice_prompt:4:1320319001.source_cn: 看你们的神色，想必已经找到那位画家了。

say:5:1320319002:1.source_cn: 没错，就是主人说的这样。

say:6:1320319003:1.text: Levski's situation is heartbreaking. He had the potential to become a remarkable artist, but fate dealt him a cruel blow with illness...
say:6:1320319003:1.source_cn: 列夫斯基的经历太惨了。他本来有机会成为一名出众的画家，...

say:7:1320319004:1.text: A bedridden artist and an unfinished masterpiece... it's a sorrowful tale.
say:7:1320319004:1.source_cn: 身染重疾的艺术家，未完成的画作……呵。

say:8:1320319005:1.text: Such stories have existed for so long; it's not uncommon to hear of similar fates.
say:8:1320319005:1.source_cn: 存在得太久，偶尔也能看到相似的故事。

choice_prompt:9:1320319005.text: Such stories have existed for so long; it's not uncommon to hear of similar fates.
choice_prompt:9:1320319005.source_cn: 存在得太久，偶尔也能看到相似的故事。

say:11:1320319009:1.text: I have one more favor to ask. I'd like to restore this painting, but I may need some special materials.
say:11:1320319009:1.source_cn: 请你们再帮我一个忙。我想要修复这幅画，可能需要一些比较...

say:12:1320319010:2.text: If it's just about fixing the canvas, magic would work perfectly!
say:12:1320319010:2.source_cn: 如果只是修复破损的话，完全可以用魔法呀！

say:14:1320319011:1.text: Absolutely! With your magic, this will be so easy-peasy! And if you need a little extra help, you've got the best mage right here to help you out!
say:14:1320319011:1.source_cn: 对啊，以你的魔法水平来说，这应该很简单。就算你不擅长，...
say:14:1320319011:1.male: Absolutely! With your magic, this will be so easy-peasy! And if you need a little extra help, you've got the best mage right here to help you out!
say:14:1320319011:1.female: Absolutely! With your magic, this will be so easy-peasy! And if you need a little extra help, you've got the best mage right here to help you out!

say:15:1320319012:1.text: Magic might fix it and add some color, but it could also overshadow the painting's inherent beauty.
say:15:1320319012:1.source_cn: 魔力或许能让它恢复如初，为它增添色彩，却也会损耗艺术品...

say:16:1320319013:1.text: The passage of time is what truly honors great artwork.
say:16:1320319013:1.source_cn: 艺术不该是这样的东西。流逝的时间，才是它的见证者。

say:17:1320319014:1.text: Let's go see how we can restore it.
say:17:1320319014:1.source_cn: 走吧。让我们看看该怎样修复它。

say:19:1320319006:2.text: I remember you saying that your parents used to decorate the manor with your paintings...
say:19:1320319006:2.source_cn: 我记得，之前你曾经提过……你父母曾经在庄园里挂满了你的画作。

say:20:1320319007:1.text: Wait... are you implying that the similar story is your own?
say:20:1320319007:1.source_cn: 难道……你说的人就是你自己吗？

choice:9:1:2.text: Have you met someone like that?
choice:9:1:2.male: Have you met someone like that?
choice:9:1:2.female: Have you met someone like that?
